needs.what: the Training keyword (702.149): a triggered ability 'Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature', present as a keyword so cards that check for or grant training can see it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: training is not in the keyword list. Hand-writing it as an 'attacks' trigger with an exists condition over other attacking creatures whose power exceeds power_of self relies on a selector power clause relative to the source, which the static/printed filter path (compare_pt) only accepts as a plain integer; the effect-selector path is unverified for this use, and it would still leave the creature without the keyword itself
